title: PopClaw world-interaction JSON Schema profile v1 (payload-schema validator)
description: TWO DISTINCT LEVELS — do not conflate them. (Meta level) THIS document is an ordinary JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) whose ROOT validates PAYLOAD SCHEMA DOCUMENTS: house manifest event/intent schemas and this bundle's payload schemas (board/action schemas, participation.schema.json, private-message.schema.json). Validating a payload schema against this root is mechanical. (Payload level) `#/$defs/schema` is the node that defines the pinned payload subset itself; a document passes iff every node conforms to it. The meta level necessarily uses a wider fixed keyword set (propertyNames, schema-valued additionalProperties) and is NOT itself payload-conformant — it is verified instead by three mechanical audit assertions in the schema conformance checks (every keyword reachable from #/$defs/schema is inside the payload whitelist; every $ref target exists; pattern grammar rules are checkable) plus review. Payload semantics: JSON parsed as bounded UTF-8 with duplicate-key rejection before any schema check; unsupported keywords/values reject the affected capability at activation — never silently ignored; total nesting depth of payload documents bounded to 8 by the validator (not expressible in-language); regex patterns restricted to the lookaround-free, backreference-free subset shared by JS RegExp and the Rust regex crate; numbers are integers only; uint64 values are decimal strings.

schema.$comment: One payload-schema node. Allowed keywords exactly: type, properties, required, additionalProperties(false only), items, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems(true only), maxProperties, enum, const, minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, exclusiveMaximum, minLength, maxLength, pattern, allOf, anyOf, oneOf, $ref(internal #/$defs/... only), $defs, $schema(annotation), plus annotations title/description/$comment.

$schema.$comment: Annotation pinning this profile on payload documents; it never selects a dialect — the profile is pinned by the contract.

propertyNames.$comment: Property NAME strings validated as strings (parent review: names were wrongly typed as objects, which rejected every name under real validators).

pattern.$comment: Grammar (no lookaround/backrefs) is a validator-side semantic check; a pattern failing it rejects the capability.

$ref.$comment: Internal, root-anchored, into $defs only. External/absolute/document-relative $ref is outside the profile.
